description: Scrape comprehensive YouTube video details including metadata, channel info, transcripts, comments, and engagement metrics.

includeCards.description: Extract interactive info cards embedded in the video.
includeCards.title: Extract Info Cards

includeChapters.description: Extract chapter markers from the video engagement panel or description timestamps.
includeChapters.title: Extract Chapters

includeEndscreen.description: Extract endscreen elements (suggested videos/channels/playlists shown at video end).
includeEndscreen.title: Extract Endscreen

includeRelatedVideos.description: Number of related/suggested videos to extract from the watch page sidebar. 0 = skip.
includeRelatedVideos.title: Max Related Videos

includeTranscriptMetadata.description: List available caption/transcript tracks (language codes, auto-generated flag). Does not fetch transcript text.
includeTranscriptMetadata.title: List Caption Tracks

maxComments.description: Maximum number of comments to extract per video. Set to 0 to skip comment extraction.
maxComments.title: Max Comments Per Video

proxyCountry.description: Country for proxy routing. Useful for geo-blocked videos.
proxyCountry.title: Proxy Country

videoUrls.description: YouTube video URLs, short links (youtu.be), shorts URLs, or plain video IDs.
videoUrls.title: Video URLs

title: YouTube Video Details Scraper Input
